method: Isolated synthetic 250 trucks / 10 branches, 350 drivers, 60 ordinary dispatchers, capital and daily condition/morale floors. 500 synthetic offers/day plus natural market; real engine simulation and deliveries. Two warmup days, remaining consecutive days measured, one additional sampled day. Per-component JSON sizes measured outside engine time. Compaction and simulated archive staging outside engine time; no browser, actual IndexedDB, cloud, production saves or historical endurance process. Not a long-game proof; fleet size and game age need separate tests.
